title: Insert Interval
statement_short: Given an array of non-overlapping intervals sorted by their start times and a newInterval, insert newInterval into intervals such that intervals is still sorted and non-overlapping, merging overlapping intervals if necessary.
hint: Pre-sorted non-overlapping input allows an O(n) linear single pass to collect left, merged, and right intervals.
keywords: non-overlapping intervals sorted by their start times
why_not: Right: Intervals single-pass linear insertion merges overlapping ranges with newInterval in O(n) time and O(n) space. Not Binary Search: Binary search locates the insertion position in O(log n) time, but merging/rebuilding the output array still requires O(n) time. Not Two Pointers: Scanning from both ends is unnecessary since intervals are already sorted by start time. Not Heap / Priority Queue: Inserting into a min-heap costs O(n log n) time, which is less optimal than linear insertion.
